 Judgment

Dated this the 05th day of February, 2026 The 2nd accused in Crime No.519 of 2025 of Alappuzha North Police Station filed this petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, praying for a direction to the Judicial First Class Magistrate-I, Alappuzha, to expedite the proceedings in Undetectable Case (UD) No.41 of 2025 pending before that court.

2. In the First Information Report, the allegations raised against the petitioner and the other accused persons are under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 323, 324 and 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The police, after conducting the investigation filed a UD report as UD No.41 of 2025, on the ground that, since the de facto complainant went abroad without informing the present whereabouts, they are not in a position to complete the investigation and file the final report.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that he wants to go to 'Umrah' at Saudi Arabia and the pendency of the above 2026:KER:11070 proceedings will stand in the way of his intention to go to 'Umrah'.
4.

The learned Public Prosecutor submitted that, since the de facto complainant did not turn up and went abroad without informing the present whereabouts, the police is not in a position to proceed with the case and that is why, the UD report was filed.
5. In the above circumstances, even if a direction is given to the learned Magistrate to expedite the proceedings of UD No.41 of 2025, no useful purpose will be served.
Therefore, this original petition is disposed of with a direction to the prosecution to complete the investigation as early as possible.

Sd/-
